map_info.name: Vectors_Act4a_KineticForces
map_info.title: What resists the journey
map_info.description: Drop the same PointBody into three large regions and compare speed-dependent drag. Walk through the same coefficients. Distinguish this resistance model and its constant upward buoyancy term from a fluid solver. Then release cubes and balls on four slopes: smooth/rough contact changes sliding and rolling. The tutorial reconstructs the point in one drag region; the ramps are comparisons. Trails retain the consequence.

learning_objectives: Speed-dependent drag, buoyancy approximation and contact friction

documentation.layout: One primary encounter, spaced comparisons, a clear perimeter route. See the curation manifest for lesson roles.
